note: A3.1 — the ANY wildcard tier. Nine parsers emit method "ANY" for method-agnostic server routes (Rails `resources`, Spring class-level @RequestMapping, Laravel Route::any, Go HandleFunc, Clojure ANY, ...). The route index keys on (METHOD, path), so an ANY route could never be reached from a typed client verb and every one of those declarations was a dead HTTP_CALLS target. Rails chosen over Django/ASP.NET deliberately: those emit paths with no leading slash and are dropped by index_route_node's legacy branch regardless of this fix.
